description: This is a React component in TypeScript that renders the main application interface for a persona builder. It manages file uploads, orchestrates backend API calls for persona generation, polls build status, and displays the resulting persona data with editable features.

methods.name: asStringArray
methods.description: Converts a value into a string array, filtering out non-string or empty entries.

methods.name: safeJsonStringify
methods.description: Safely converts a value to a formatted JSON string, catching errors.

methods.name: getErrorMessage
methods.description: Extracts a human-readable error message from various error types.

methods.name: isNonEmptyObject
methods.description: Checks if a value is an object with at least one key.

methods.name: getInitials
methods.description: Returns initials from a label string, used for avatar display.

methods.name: getNestedOrchestrationValue
methods.description: Safely retrieves nested values from an object given a path array.

methods.name: logAvailableKeys
methods.description: Logs top-level and nested 'artifacts' keys to the console for debugging.

methods.name: extractPersonaJsonFromOrchestrationRecord
methods.description: Extracts persona JSON data from orchestration response, following candidate paths and heuristics.

methods.name: coercePersonaDataFromBackendJson
methods.description: Maps backend persona JSON into the UI's PersonaData structure, handling various formats.
